title: Friday Daily Practice
subtitle: Preview Sunday: comparing charts
source: Daily Practice tuần 2 (print/I3/Daily_Practice_Week2_source.md), bài I3 Leisure and Recreation
intro: Today you take Weekly Quiz 2, sent privately by the teacher on Zalo at 7:00 (about 60 minutes). The web only has 2 preparation steps for Sunday, about 15 minutes. Deadline 00:00 tonight. Complete and on time earns 20 Meow; late or half done earns 10 Meow. Do not look at the answers before you finish.

steps.title: Step 1 · Six phrases for comparing charts
steps.instructions: Learn the 6 phrases, then fill in the English phrase that matches each meaning. For 'while', accept both whereas and while.

items.label: 1. cao hơn đáng kể so với = ______
2. thấp hơn một chút so với = ______
6. phổ biến nhất với khoảng cách xa = ______

steps.title: Step 2 · One sentence for each phrase
steps.instructions: Write one sentence about Vietnam or your own city for each phrase in Step 1. Type all 6 sentences in the box below.

open.model: Rents in Hanoi are considerably higher than rents in Hue. The price of coffee is slightly lower than the price of tea. Petrol is twice as much as water here. Young people have the highest proportion of phone users. Hanoi is crowded whereas my village is quiet. Football is by far the most popular sport in Vietnam.

send_today: Hoàn thành 2 bước trên web. Bài quiz chụp ảnh gửi lên Zalo theo hướng dẫn của thầy.
